invariants.rationale: The writeConfig parameter is expected to be non-null when createIndex is called.

meta.value: writeConfig is never null at method entry

invariants.rationale: Assuming some important configuration field in writeConfig must be non-null for index creation.
The parallelism setting in writeConfig should be positive to create an index.
The index type must be specified in the config to create the proper index.
Index creation only occurs if indexing is enabled in the configuration.
